description.p: Clip Keep is a clipboard history applet for the COSMIC desktop. It keeps what you copy in a searchable list behind a panel button, so a snippet you copied twenty minutes ago is still there when you need it. Type to narrow the list and press Enter to make an earlier item available on the clipboard again.

On its first start, Clip Keep tries to register Super+V as its global shortcut. It never replaces an existing shortcut: if that combination is already in use, choose any combination in COSMIC Settings and assign it the command flatpak run io.github.marcelogomes90.cosmic-ext-applet-clip-keep --toggle. A shortcut created automatically or manually can be changed later in COSMIC Settings.

Clip Keep jest apletem schowka dla środowiska COSMIC. Zachowuje on wszystko co skopiowałeś w łatwym do wyszukiwania formacie w formie przycisku na panelu, więc urywek który skopiowałeś kwadrans temu jest dalej dostępny, gdy go potrzebujesz. Zacznij pisać by zawężyć wyszukiwanie i naciśnij Enter by wcześniejszy element był znowu bezpośrednio w schowku.
A clipboard manager sits between every application on the desktop and has to be trusted with what passes through. Clip Keep is organised around three things going wrong:
Menadżer schowka jest pomiędzy każdą inną aplikacją w systemie, więc musi być godny zaufania nad powierzonymi mu danymi. Clip Keep jest uodporniony na trzy wektory zagrożeń:

ul.li: Reading a selection must never hold up the application that owns it. Only the formats worth keeping are ever requested, every transfer has a timeout and a size ceiling, and the reads run alongside the event loop rather than blocking it, so copying a large image out of a browser cannot freeze the browser.

Odczytanie zaznaczenia nigdy nie może blokować aplikacji do której należą dane. Tylko formaty możliwe do skopiowania są żadane, każdy przesył ma limit czasowy i rozmiarowy, i odczytanie zawiera się w cyklu wydarzenia zamiast blokowania go, więc kopiowanie dużych obrazów z przeglądarki ni zawiesza jej.
History has to stay small in memory. The list holds only what it draws, images are stored as pre-scaled thumbnails, and a full image is loaded when it is previewed and dropped when it is not.
Ślad historii w pamięci musi być mały. Lista zawiera tylko to co jest zapisane, obrazy są zapisywane jako miniaturki a duże obrazy są ładowane tylko podczas podglądu i usuwane z pamięci po nim.
Some things should never be recorded. Entries carrying a password manager hint can be discarded, private mode pauses capture, and the history file is readable only by you.

Niektóre rzeczy nigdy nie powinne być zapisywane, Każdy element zawierający sugestię że jest hasłem jest odrzucany, tryb prywatny przerywa zapis i pliki historii są dostępne do odczytu tylko dla ciebie.

description.p: Capture uses the COSMIC compositor's data-control protocol and stays on the local machine.
Kopiowanie używa protokołu data-control kompozytora COSMIC i nie opuszcza fizycznie komputera.

Clip Keep je applet historie schránky pro prostředí COSMIC. Uchovává zkopírovaný obsah v prohledávatelném seznamu, který otevřete tlačítkem na panelu, takže i úryvek zkopírovaný před dvaceti minutami budete mít stále po ruce. Psaním můžete seznam zúžit a stisknutím klávesy Enter znovu zpřístupnit starší položku ve schránce.
Mezi všemi aplikacemi v prostředí stojí správce schránky, který musí mít přístup k tomu, co jimi prochází. Clip Keep je navržen s ohledem na tři věci, které se mohou pokazit:

ul.li: Čtení výběru nikdy nesmí zdržovat aplikaci, která jej vlastní. Vyžadovány jsou pouze formáty, které má smysl uchovávat. Každý přenos má časový limit a maximální velikost. Čtení probíhá souběžně se smyčkou událostí, aniž by ji blokovalo, takže kopírování velkého obrázku z prohlížeče nemůže zablokovat samotný prohlížeč.

Historie musí zůstat paměťově nenáročná. Seznam uchovává pouze to, co zobrazuje. Obrázky jsou uložené jako předem zmenšené náhledy. Celý obrázek se načte při zobrazení náhledu a po jeho zavření se uvolní.
Některé věci by se nikdy neměly zaznamenávat. Položky označené upozorněním správce hesel lze zahodit, soukromý režim pozastaví zachytávání a soubor s historií můžete číst pouze vy.

description.p: Zachytávání využívá protokol data-control kompozitoru COSMIC a probíhá pouze na místním počítači.

description.p: Clip Keep is ready for COSMIC Epoch 1.8 and its updated application library.

ul.li: Updates libcosmic and the panel integration to the revisions shipped with COSMIC Epoch 1.8.
Adapts popup surface messages to the new typed surface API.
Updates the TinySkia renderer while preserving the protection against transient surface resize failures.
Downsamples large images to their drawing size and caches the result, reducing rendering work and memory bandwidth for image previews.
Updates Rust dependencies, Flatpak sources, and GitHub Actions.

description.p: The history holds five times as much, and the settings fit in the popup instead of scrolling inside it.

ul.li: Raises the ceiling on the history size from 100 entries to 500.

Stops the settings scrolling while their content still fits. The popup stopped growing at 588px and the settings needed a little over 600, so they scrolled from the first line on; both the history and the settings now have 800 to grow into.
Replaces the four stacked radio buttons that chose when entries are discarded with a dropdown on the row itself, giving the setting the same shape as every other one.
Gives each setting's label the width its row has left over, rather than half of it, which had "History size" wrapping over three lines beside its control on a spacious desktop.
Holds the horizontal inset of the settings rows at a single value whatever the density chooses.
Puts the history settings above privacy, which also leaves the discard menu the room to open downwards.

description.p: The panel button keeps the spacing the rest of the panel keeps, and the installed files carry the name the applet does.

ul.li: Lets the panel draw the button as tightly as the applets beside it, which had it standing in a wider gap than any of its neighbours.
Puts the applet's own icon on the panel button, in place of the stock paste icon that drew lighter than everything beside it.
Renames the two binaries to cosmic-ext-applet-clip-keep and cosmic-ext-applet-clip-keep-dump, after the applet id.

description.p: Resting on an entry now tells you everything about it, and the list itself is quieter.

ul.li: Opens a card beside the popup when the pointer rests on an entry, holding much more of its text along with the application it was copied from, when it was first copied and last used, how many times, and its size or pixel dimensions.
Keeps the line breaks and the indentation of what you copied, so a snippet of code reads as code instead of one long paragraph, and remembers ten times as much of it.
Replaces the expanding preview panel at the foot of the popup, which sat far from the entry it belonged to.
Marks the entry under the pointer, and labels the pinned and history sections with an icon.
Writes dates the way the interface language does, and names the source application readably rather than by its reverse-domain identifier.
Counts a paste once instead of once per monitor.
Fixes a crash that made the panel button vanish and return when the popup was opened and closed quickly.
Removes the keyboard shortcuts, which never reached the popup.
Keeps a searchable history of the text, files, and images you copy, and puts any entry back on the clipboard with one click.
Pins the entries worth keeping. A pinned entry sits in its own section and survives the entry limit, the age limit, and clearing the history.
Shows images as thumbnails and loads a full one only while it is on screen, so a history full of screenshots is not a history full of screenshots in memory.
Reads a selection without holding up the application that owns it: only the formats worth keeping are requested, and every transfer has a timeout and a size ceiling.
Skips entries an application marked as a password, and pauses recording entirely in private mode.
Runs one instance per monitor, as COSMIC panels do, and keeps every list in step with the others.
Drives the whole list from the keyboard, and shrinks the popup to whatever it is showing.
Translated into English, Brazilian Portuguese, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, and Ukrainian.
